status: Non-authoritative migration ledger; normalized entries are provisional, not an exhaustive or independently approved obligation count.
limitations: All canonical source bytes and generated facts here come from the pinned committed baseline, not the earlier dirty product tree.
The 126 repository entries include 3 non-authoritative analysis principles after correcting the frozen-baseline source. Session instructions were removed from the portable inventory.
Disposition and mechanism references are migration triage. They do not certify full semantic coverage, accepted extraction, or implementation completion.
Precise anchors establish what was cited; a human review still determines whether a normalized statement faithfully represents it.
Legacy document roles, file classifications and generic artifact roles are distinct taxonomies; unknown generic roles do not establish absence of legacy governance.
Private machine census, access gaps, raw transcripts and local execution selections remain outside this portable ledger.

normalization_changes.reason: User/session instructions are not portable repository policy.

normalization_changes.change: source corrected to the work-type fixed historical corpus section
normalization_changes.reason: The postmortem is observational; the explicit frozen-treatment rule is in the work-type contract.
Existing machinery establishes a bounded contract, not the whole semantic or migration obligation.

dispositions.existing_script: Existing bounded machinery is referenced; coverage limits are shared below. This is not a complete semantic guarantee.
dispositions.partial_and_review: Mechanisms assist a bounded part; the remaining meaning, adequacy, exceptions or acceptance need human review.
dispositions.human_review: The cited obligation requires judgement. Skills may guide it but cannot enforce or approve it.
dispositions.skill_workflow: A reusable procedure assists execution without acquiring policy authority or replacing required gates.
dispositions.project_binding: Concrete values, paths, commands, thresholds and identities stay with the adopting project.
dispositions.deferred_decision: The baseline records a decision/review/evidence boundary; this ledger does not activate it.

obligations: Inspect implementation, tests and design before changes; search existing utilities.
Preserve intended behaviour unless the task changes it; prefer bounded extension and reuse.
Maintain one semantic owner; adapters translate and authorities decide.
Keep functions cohesive, nesting shallow and ownership clear; avoid compression as an optimization.
Public and cross-layer incompatibilities require migration decisions, updated consumers and evidence.
Comments explain intent, invariants, boundaries and failure modes.
Suppressions are local, justified debt and cannot conceal broad violations or weaken tests.
Track open debt with location, owner, impact, trigger and disposition; avoid parallel registers.
Use fresh-context patches locally and deterministic rewrites mechanically; change method after a rejected attempt.
Preserve UTF-8 without BOM and reject literal escape artifacts.
Prefer standard library, existing utilities/dependencies, maintained packages, then justified custom code.
Evaluate maintenance, correctness, licensing, platform, build, size and security; avoid trivial dependencies.
Search and maintain the shared utility ownership index when ownership changes.
Distinguish inherited reference behaviour from new capabilities; new capabilities do not require an artificial oracle.
Compose route defaults with task, actual diff, affected layers, claims, contracts and risk.
Repository-changing work requires nonempty evidence; omitted defaults need justification.
Review-only applies to unchanged tracked state when executable evidence and full gate are unnecessary.
Cross-layer work requires multiple affected layers, a scope matrix and provider, consumer and integration evidence.
Replay, trace, schema and identity changes require compatibility and replay evidence.
Platform claims require named-platform evidence and cannot be satisfied by another platform.
Release claims require packaging, platform and release acceptance evidence.
Claims needing human visual or usability judgment require separate human evidence.
Authority changes require transfer/establishment protocol and conformance evidence.
Tests prove behaviour, invariants, regression, errors or parity; never weaken tests to fit implementation.
Golden evidence identifies oracle, inputs, config, expected results, comparison, tolerance and purpose.
Native and Godot changes require applicable core, adapter and product-facing evidence.
Validators test success, failure, advisory/strict modes, valid suppressions and excluded paths.
Each actual enforcement family has exactly one canonical owner; registry coverage derives from the real runner graph.
After rewrites inspect encoding/escape artifacts and run focused lint.
Environment, worktree, Git and shell integration tests are authoritative under the declared canonical gate environment.
Use focused checks first; serialize full verification/CI gates and default to quiet output.
Checks consume one governed interpreter, execution mode and source binding.
Authority/governance/shared-infrastructure changes, uncertainty, review/release claims and route requirements trigger the full gate.
Report exact commands/results, omissions, manual evidence, warnings, risks and unverified areas; success requires successful execution.
Verbose mode changes logs while preserving checks, environment and verdicts.
Never expose secrets/private data in source, artifacts, logs, screenshots or public metadata.
Use fake placeholders/redacted examples; report detected secrets without copying them.
External/user-controlled strings pass approved sanitation, explicit allowlists/ranges and deterministic error handling.
Use existing helpers, standard-library parsing or a reviewed shared helper; deviations need rationale and tests.
Reject blocked dependencies and evaluate package safety and utility reuse.
Preserve unrelated changes and stage explicit intentional paths after reviewing staged content.
Tracked paths may not also match Git ignore rules; use Git native semantics.
Exclude machine state, credentials, local metadata and unrelated formatting from commits.
Destructive/production actions require task authorization and verified targets.
Writes use the declared canonical publication target and verified owner/transport identity; ambiguity stops publication.
Do not publish identity-check details or local paths.
Workspace indexes coordinate membership; machine overlays contain allowed execution locations rather than project semantics.
RDS/schema/architecture owners determine semantics; generated views cannot acquire authority.
Machine policy contains current facts/enforcement inputs rather than migrations, execution history or branch diaries.
Prefer structured owners, roles, paths, schemas and lexical tokens over unrestricted policy narrative.
All writers use the owning deterministic serializer; canonical verification checks exact bytes.
Inherited/runtime/presentation constants use their declared owner without independent semantic redefinition.
Nontrivial behaviour/layout/timing/budget values use existing config and accessors or a new canonical key.
True invariants, versions, sentinels and trivial identities may stay inline; mutable exceptions need rationale, migration and evidence.
Change owning source/schema/contract/generator and regenerate outputs in the same change.
Outputs identify source/generator and use deterministic traversal/rendering.
Tracked config is discoverable in generated references except documented exclusions; settings use stable config-derived categories.
Resolve, narrowly justify/suppress or track advisory findings; stricter modes follow applicable contracts.
Classify inherited versus new behaviour and deterministic/presentation/data ownership before implementation.
Ports preserve scoped reference behaviour, parity, compatibility and fallback until explicit transfer.
New capabilities require normative contract, named owners, conformance/compatibility evidence and establishment record.
Product-shell/adapters may present and request state but cannot recompute inherited deterministic truth.
Semantic-boundary scanning covers declared production/test roots; exceptions are explicit and names do not confer semantic authority.
Keep deterministic core independent of framework headers; adapters convert boundary types and stay thin.
Prefer value/automatic storage and RAII; choose unique/shared/weak ownership according to lifetime.
Avoid raw owning pointers, naked allocation, detached threads, unexplained mutable globals, unsafe casts and arrays; justified exceptions are narrow.
Stored framework pointers declare owner, lifetime, nullability, invalidation and access rules.
Public APIs document ownership, lifetime, nullability, invariants, pre/postconditions, failure and semantic authority.
Native tooling discovers project-owned files, excludes vendors and preserves declared advisory/strict requirements.
Build, export, cross-compile and link prove their boundary; real device/runtime acceptance remains separate.
Explicit task instructions and declared authority ownership govern conflicts; stale lower text is repaired or retired.
Select every matching route and union authorities, dispatch and evidence; routes do not assign exclusive ownership.
Review-only, staged handoff, cross-layer and verification failure describe execution context independently of subsystem.
Inspect current sources and state a concise plan with explicit acceptance criteria against owning design.
Keep one semantic objective, allowed/forbidden scope, explicit deferrals and cross-layer scope matrix.
Report LOC delta and prefer reduction for non-feature refactors without optimizing compressed counts.
Changed behaviour always needs appropriate behavioural/regression evidence.
Update design/docs/backlog when documented semantics, architecture, authority, contracts, debt or validity changes; stronger task instructions may require more.
Prefer staged additive migrations; verify before retiring predecessors and avoid silent continuation into the next stage.
Preserve generated provenance, sanitation, deterministic identity, replay/trace compatibility and explicit deferrals.
Classify governance, state, active tasks, plans, history, architecture, product contracts, templates and generated references.
Active routed sources are tracked/current and exclude history; reviewability limits do not justify semantic compression.
Backlog owns conditional open work; current state owns restart/handoff; neither is a general task log.
Retire backlog items when completed/obsolete, preserve unresolved rationale/dependencies, and keep historical chronology outside active governance.
Active handoff names its feature branch/draft PR; default/non-draft merge boundary has none and empty notes; incomplete event context fails closed.
Binding safety ceilings and structural/canonical checks remain independent; governability targets require evidence calibration.
Current routed docs avoid completed-execution headings and volatile suite inventories; immutable historical references remain valid.
Distinguish implemented, automated, inspected, human accepted, published and merged; unresolved required acceptance blocks completion.
Report routes/modifiers, layers/claims, owners/evidence, omissions, checks, risks, scope, authority effects and publication/worktree state.
Support targets change only through deliberate product-plan authority, contract/RDS/consumer/backlog/test reconciliation.
Release filename identity follows the declared product token; named transitional status exceptions cannot bypass identity.
Maintain the declared human owner domains; overlapping durable rules require domain-model review.
Generic pack owns mechanisms; workspace membership, project facts/human references and local runtime locations have distinct owners.
Pack mechanisms do not embed project identities, variables, authority IDs or manifest locations.
Conflicting exclusive facts fail with provenance; no implicit discovery-order precedence resolves them.
Stable resolved facts with provenance suffice; reopen sources for omitted semantics, ambiguity, boundaries, audit or authority edits.
Validate authority/route reachability, facade parity and generated relationships.
Declared fields are consumed, validation-only or explicitly reserved; reserved claims are not implemented capabilities.
Validate interpreter/version/import/dependency/source origin and fail on unusable authoritative selections.
Source versus installed mode is declared; bind the invoking checkout and reject foreign/duplicate distribution authority.
Shared environments accept only certifiably compatible dependency declarations and keep cumulative requirements.
Bootstrap consumes resolver decisions, isolates shared mutation locks, validates installed requirements and never steals live/ambiguous locks.
Execution modes bound discovery breadth without waiving evidence.
Representative scenario matching is priority-based with ties rejected; it is not general task classification.
Version/revision/manifest hashes identify vendored bytes; ordinary checks expose drift and explicit sync accepts reviewed updates.
Pack schema changes follow declared release compatibility rules and revisions track byte changes.
Canonical extraction requires immutable upstream/release identity, publisher/trust owner and deterministic reconstruction/export.
Recording is opt-in, secret-safe and private; recording failure does not alter command outcomes.
Observations have immutable IDs, source/provenance, observed/persisted times and confidence for evidence-based correlation.
Capture records agent/runtime activity without requiring agents to log ordinary actions; snapshots do not prove attribution.
Raw transcript retention and telemetry retention are separate; logs/keys remain outside the repository.
Generic recording/reconstruction belongs to the pack; project interpretation, calibration and causal evaluation remain external.
Substantive segments are Planning, Coding or Manifest according to kind of work; verification inherits the verified work type.
Work type, route and execution mode remain independent; route/dispatch membership cannot infer artifact role.
Artifact roles are explicitly declared/projected with provenance; unknown roles stay uncertainty rather than guesses.
Attributable segment writes test work-type compatibility; reads and whole-session final diffs do not establish segment attribution.
The log-only observer uses treatment captured at segment start; candidate edits cannot relabel their earlier writes.
Compare obligations under base/candidate treatment and union surfaces/immutable roots; preserved, weakened and indeterminate are distinct.
Strengthening direction follows field meaning, not type; unknown fields require human review.
Changes to enforcement/bootstrap roots are judged by the base machinery and cannot hide the changed checker.
Explicit-role handoff requires relevant coverage, route equivalence and human acceptance; log-only precedes approved blocking.
Assess retrieval, selection, reconstruction, mutation, contradiction detection, performance and real task outcomes before setting quality targets.
Compliance, passing checks and temporal proximity do not establish causal governance usefulness.
Preserve unavailable/not-inferable/unknown distinctions and do not reconstruct unsupported outcomes or identity.
Historical experiments retain frozen treatment identity instead of rewriting baselines to current policy.

project_bindings.project_binding: All concrete bindings in the generated authority/route views, commands, toolchains, budgets, artifact naming, runtime-data paths and renderer adapters remain consumer-owned.
project_bindings.generic_candidate: Reuse contracts and parameterized mechanisms only after coverage/review acceptance; retain one semantic owner through each transfer.

family_coverage.contracts: Validates declared project-contract structure and references; domain meaning and behavioural conformance remain review/evidence duties.
family_coverage.workspace_bundle: Checks exported bundle declarations and source correspondence; an immutable upstream and legitimate publisher require an accepted source contract.
family_coverage.authority_transfer: Validates transfer/establishment records and declared evidence references; reviewers decide semantic parity and legitimate ownership.
family_coverage.config_authority: Flags bounded configuration/constant ownership patterns, with advisory and stricter modes; cannot decide every constant or exception semantically.
family_coverage.godot_semantic_boundary: Discovers declared production/test domains and flags bounded semantic-risk patterns; does not prove every gameplay boundary correct.
family_coverage.live_board_visual_roles: Checks declared visual-role separation; human visual quality and domain semantics remain separate evidence.
family_coverage.native_cpp_tooling: Discovers project-owned native files and invokes selected clang tools; skips/advisory results and semantic/parity evidence remain explicit.
family_coverage.menu_graph: Checks the declared menu graph and structural links; human usability and intended navigation semantics require review.
family_coverage.risk_gates: Checks declared risky patterns and conditions; authorization and real production/publication targets require task-specific judgement.
family_coverage.policy_runtime_rules: Checks configured lexical/runtime rule patterns; complete input sanitation and deterministic semantics are not established by matching.
family_coverage.wheel_reuse_rules: Checks declared dependency/reimplementation patterns; maintenance, licensing and proportionality decisions remain human.
family_coverage.utility_reuse: Checks registered utility/index rules and bounded reuse patterns; cannot prove a custom helper is warranted or existing code is suitable.
family_coverage.loc_guidance: Measures declared physical-line constraints; cohesion, architectural quality and non-compression are reviewed separately.
family_coverage.dedup_dead_code_rules: Flags configured dead-code/duplicate-code indicators; equivalent semantics and justified exceptions require review.
family_coverage.drift_protection: Checks declared drift constraints against current sources; product meaning and compatible migration remain independently reviewed.
family_coverage.product_platform_matrix: Validates product/platform cells, registered consumers and artifact identities; runtime/device acceptance is not supplied.
family_coverage.policy_pack_canonical: Compares bytes with the one owning serializer; unchanged decoded JSON cannot replace canonical-byte correspondence.
family_coverage.governance_surface: Validates registered roles, current surfaces, canonical owners and structural/size limits; proxy compliance does not prove useful context.
family_coverage.policy_compliance: Runs the consumer policy shell checks; coverage must be traced to invoked rules before migration, not inferred from the family label.
family_coverage.policy_compliance_repo: Runs repository-wide declared policy checks; bounded pattern coverage does not establish all engineering or security obligations.
family_coverage.git_sanitation_repo: Uses Git-native semantics for tracked/ignored overlap and repository hygiene; preserving unrelated work still requires intentional edits/staging.
family_coverage.topology_contract_codegen: Regenerates declared topology-contract outputs and compares exact bytes; renderer/domain semantics remain Tet4D-owned.
family_coverage.config_reference: Checks CONFIGURATION_REFERENCE and USER_SETTINGS_REFERENCE with the existing Tet4D generator; generic migration must preserve both outputs and use an adapter.
family_coverage.maintenance_docs: Checks generated structure/current-state blocks; operational restart completeness and prose validity remain review duties.
family_coverage.secret_scan: Scans declared tracked surfaces for bounded secret patterns; does not prove the absence of all private data or unauthorized disclosure.
family_coverage.pygame_ce: Checks declared pygame-ce dependency/import expectations; general dependency suitability and other runtime contracts remain separate.
family_coverage.godot_settings_externalization: Checks configured Godot settings/constant patterns; appropriate externalization and stable setting meaning remain reviewed.
family_coverage.ruff: Runs the declared Ruff check scope; lint success does not establish behavioural correctness.
family_coverage.ruff_format: Checks formatting over the declared scope; formatting is not architecture or semantic evidence.
family_coverage.ruff_c901: Checks the declared complexity rule/scope; cohesion and justified complexity remain review duties.
family_coverage.arch_metrics_soft_gate: Checks declared architecture metrics with its configured soft-gate treatment; observed metrics are proxies, not architectural proof.
family_coverage.arch_metrics_budgets: Checks declared architecture/debt budgets; appropriate thresholds and the completeness of debt tracking require review.
family_coverage.handoff_lifecycle: Validates handoff state, Git/PR context and event completeness; restart sufficiency and preserved unresolved rationale require inspection.

gov-core.coverage: Schema, reachability, contradiction, facade and integrity contracts; cannot create human policy or infer arbitrary task intent.

gov-environment.coverage: Declared interpreter/source/dependency certification and guarded bootstrap; the baseline still assumes Python application metadata.

evidence-resolver.coverage: Composes declared requirements and platform/lane choices; task-specific claims, complete risk and actual evidence quality require review.

verification-runner.coverage: Invokes declared gates with the selected environment; passing does not validate this migration proposal or human acceptance.

gov-roles.coverage: Explicit declarations and temporary bootstrap projection; relevant unknown roles remain uncertainty and semantic handoff is not automatic.

gov-telemetry.coverage: Opt-in first-hand gov observations are implemented; agent importers and reconstruction remain planned at this baseline.

work-segment-observer.coverage: Captured-treatment log-only judgement over interval changes; snapshots alone do not attribute writes and the observer never enables blocking.

postmortem-analysis.coverage: Descriptive evidence and explicit unknowns; exposure gaps remain and causal usefulness is not inferred.

governance-context.coverage: New workflow assistance; discovery and representative-task testing are required, and mandatory enforcement remains in runners.

governance-maintenance.coverage: New migration workflow assistance; required human/independent gates and stronger local rules remain applicable.

baseline_decisions.decision: Canonical upstream, immutable release and publisher/trust owner
baseline_decisions.status: Requires owner/architecture acceptance before canonical external extraction.
Requires independent review of the repaired contract; family-specific conformance remains necessary.
Baseline is paused; current user authorization and updated owners determine current activation, never this historical ledger.
Relevant explicit coverage, route equivalence and human acceptance are required.
Explicit evidence/owner acceptance remains distinct from general implementation authorization.
Retained raw before evidence and exposure limitations must be preserved; no savings claim from Tet4D alone.
